name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) 2021/694, (EU) 2021/695, (EU) 2021/697, (EU) 2021/1153, (EU) 2023/1525 and 2024/795, as regards incentivising defence-related investments in the EU budget to implement the ReArm Europe Plan
part_text:
The European Parliament wants to let several existing EU funding programmes pay for defence and security projects. It adds a new defence and security category to a platform that channels money to strategic technologies. It opens research funding to civilian products that could also have military uses, and lets defence projects get EU money. It also makes it easier to spend EU transport money on roads, railways and fuel supplies that armies could use. No new money is created.

- **What changes:** Existing EU programmes can now fund defence, security and dual-use projects, including military transport routes.
- **Who it affects:** Defence and tech companies, researchers, and countries that choose to move regional funds into these projects.
- **What happens next:** Parliament has set its position; talks with EU governments follow before the rules become law.
